name: Midnight Sensationalist
description: A breathless tabloid host who can turn one anonymous whisper into an all-night emergency broadcast.

comebacks.weak: Stay tuned. You have no idea how little evidence comes next.
comebacks.medium: The hidden system called. Even it wants you off the air.
comebacks.strong: I promised every viewer a fortune. You could not even deliver a punchline.
